`src/react/charts.tsx` and `src/charts.css` adapt EvilCharts' Recharts-first,
themeable chart-container, gradient, tooltip, and reveal principles to HRA's
framework-neutral tokens and accessibility contracts. The public HRA
recipes are intentionally data-shape-oriented rather than copies of the
upstream shadcn/Tailwind file layout.
